question: In the Police Retirement System of St. Louis (PRS-STL) actuarial RFP, how many years of experience must the principal actuary have?
expected_facts: A minimum of five years of professional actuarial experience, plus a minimum of five years of experience testifying before legislative and administrative bodies.
acceptance: Five years professional actuarial experience is the core number. A complete description may state the separate five-year testimony requirement; these are not additive ten years and may overlap. Credentials are optional for this question.
